items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Mr. Cook in their response; the name 'Mr. Cook' is only used by the interviewer to address the interviewee.

ctx.x: We played what we call the right time at that time. See, it was the same type of music that Tom played at Seventh and Magazine. He played in Chicago. That was named jazz then after it got up there. But before that, the people in New Orleans as itself, we never knew anything about jazz. We never thought of calling it jazz. But after it got up there, they called it jazz.
Now, Mr. Cook, you mentioned some good bands at Seventh and Magazine. No, the only two I said that they had in the city was Blessing and Brown. Blessing.
Don't you remember Fisher's band? Fisher, yeah.
